verification_steps.description: Verify thread-safe generator registration and abort signalling via GenerationManager.
Verify DB entries contain initial prompt and in_progress=True upon stream start.
Simulate client disconnect (GeneratorExit) and verify thread pool executes background queue draining to completion.
Call POST /v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/abort on active generation, and verify thread is cancelled immediately and status is set to INTERRUPTED.
Verify exception recovery guarantees in_progress=False and status=ERROR when generator yields exceptions.
Verify abort idempotency in ConversationService preserves INTERRUPTED status against late drain completion.
